For a café in Kochi, I’d shortlist these:

Western SRC 500-GL 500L Visi Cooler

500L Two-Door Vertical Refrigerator
₹50,000•Spacious 500L capacity for large storage requirements.
Celfrost 2-Door Reach-In 500L
₹1,32,700•Durable two-door design with ample 500L space.
Give feedback

Western SRC 500-GL — ~₹39,890. Good for beverages/display; glass door and 5-star efficiency. 
Smartprix

500L SS vertical refrigerator — ~₹50,000. Better for kitchen ingredients; adjustable racks and 5-star energy rating.

Celfrost VRI 550 — ~₹1.33 lakh. Premium 2-door reach-in option for heavier commercial use.

What to check: 400–500L capacity, 0–8°C operating range, tropicalised compressor (important in Kochi), SS304/SS430 construction, auto-defrost, removable magnetic gaskets, caster wheels, energy consumption, warranty and local Kochi service availability. For a busy café, forced-air circulation is preferable for uniform cooling.
